body: Measured product decision for existing Smart Preview UI: default UseSmartPreviews must be FALSE while originals are available. Keep explicit user opt-in/source choice. Native matched2460x1638 measurement on A: proxyCPU warm edit384.7ms versus originalMetal resident includingreadback33.07ms, so current proxy route is about11.6x slower than existing originalMetal. CPUoriginal818.2ms, so CPU-only improvement does not justify an automatic default. Please add source regression for absent-preference default original; preserve explicit saved preference. For offline original with valid proxy, offer clear Use Smart Preview action/state rather than telling user to build an already-existing preview. Do not silently change source after a failed opener. This is bounded Swift source follow-up; noBbuilds/workloads, nativeAPIunchanged. Publish handoff with earlier status coalescing/thumbnail follow-up. A owns runtime and merges.
